title: Simplicity
description: A nice and simple texture pack with "Max Pooled look" just means it makes 4px into a color of 1
body:
# MaxPool Pixel-Grid [8x8 / 4:1 Ratio]

MaxPool is a performance-first resource pack designed to streamline Minecraft’s visual density. By utilizing a "pixel-pooling" logic where a single solid color represents what would normally be a 4-pixel cluster this pack reduces visual noise and creates a distinct, ultra-clean aesthetic.

Perfect for competitive play, technical testing, or players running on high-refresh-rate monitors who need every frame possible.

Key Features

4-to-1 Pixel Mapping: Every 4 pixels are "pooled" into a single cohesive color block, resulting in a crisp 8x8 resolution that stays true to the vanilla palette while removing distracting grain.

Enhanced Visibility: By simplifying textures into solid color blocks, entity silhouettes and block outlines become significantly easier to track, making it an ideal choice for high-speed gameplay.



Technical Specifications

Resolution: 8x8 (Optimized for 4:1 pixel density)

Format: Version 26.1.2 compatible (will be added to previous and future option)

Style: Minimalist / Geometric
